scope: Carry completed RAW demosaic quality through cached pixels and Auto fits; publish a complete single-flight result before joined requests return.
implementation: Retain actual demosaic quality alongside the cached image and export it in DecodedSnapshot.
Metal and CPU fallback Auto fitting use the retained quality, including cached higher-quality refinement.
Full/AMaZE replaces an equal-resolution Preview; a covering higher-quality decode may be retained for Preview and returns its matching image.
Joined requests await normalization and cache publication; obsolete publication cannot replace newer requests.
Full-resolution legacy decode records the selected Full/AMaZE preference rather than its requested Preview default.
Invalidation, preview seeds and cancellation release/reset the appropriate metadata and in-flight publication.

qualification.ciChange: DecodedCacheReplacementTests moved to the executable regression list; all six tests use the committed synthetic RAW and require no Metal device.

rejectedExperiment.policy: Make full/sized/detail CPU renders reuse the fixed 1536px standalone Auto fit.
rejectedExperiment.decision: Removed after introducing Auto ACR budget breaches; budgets unchanged.

limits: Normal live GPU/export fit-size policy still differs; photographic matched-native Metal evidence is a control, not a fix for production fit policy.
The cache tests do not qualify Auto photo quality, live canvas/export parity, inference quality, native-detail consistency, scanout or a 16ms physical-gesture budget.
Observed cached render timing is descriptive and is not the native GPU performance gate.
Native full-resolution 100MP float export memory, crowd selection/removal quality, companion portability/recovery and signed distribution remain open.
No model rollout, release, PR push/merge, or Web/mobile/Windows qualification is claimed; Mac first, ports deferred.
